description: Optional async provider that supplies foreign-exchange rates to TmCurrencyInput. When a provider is supplied, the component fetches the rate for a conversion and multiplies the entered amount by it; when no provider is supplied, the component falls back to its existing callback-based ConvertAsync FX so existing consumers keep working unchanged. For a ready-made implementation, use InMemoryExchangeRateProvider.

members.name: GetRateAsync
members.description: Returns the multiplier to convert one unit of fromCurrency into toCurrency (toAmount = fromAmount * rate). Returns null when the rate is unavailable, signalling the consumer to keep the existing value rather than converting.

parameters.name: ct
parameters.description: Token used to cancel the operation.
